verdict.rationale: Aider's docs mention configuring via environment variables (e.g., AIDER_xxx) and command-line model selection (e.g., anthropic/claude-3-opus), implying API-key-based authentication to LLM providers rather than an account login, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents an API-key auth flow or explains there is no account-login alternative. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API key setup/authentication flow, confirmation that no account-login option exists, independent corroboration of the auth mechanism.
